test_title: PYST 22: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 14 Mar 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Establish
solution:
The correct answer is 'Displace'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Establish is a verb which means to set up on a firm or permanent basis.
 
• The meaning of the given options are as follows - 
 
 
• Create - bring (something) into existence.
 
• Endow - provide with a quality, ability, or asset.
 
• Provide - make available for use; supply.
 
• Displace - remove (someone or something).
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is evident that **displace **is the correct antonym for the word establish.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Create **is synonymous to **establish.**
 
• **Endow **and **provide **are synonymous to each other.
